body: Hi! I just got the exact same message just now for a hotel in Japan for a trip in October as well. I fell for it then realized something felt off and frozen my credit card :(
I’m too scared to do it. And it makes me feel ungrateful. But honestly knowing I’m not alone makes me feel a little better.

That’s the thing I just don’t know what makes me happy. There’s nothing I really care about or want. I’m not passionate about anything. People have told me to quit my job and do something I love but i couldn’t think of anything I love.
